meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Haan — Indian skin tones ke liye **white-cast avoid karna hai toh lightweight chemical/hybrid sunscreen** generally safest bet hota hai. 2026 ke current options mein meri top picks:

### 🥇 Best overall: Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50 PA++++
### [Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50]()
*₹315*

- **No white cast** aur lightweight, non-greasy finish.
- SPF 50 + **PA++++**
- Water/sweat resistant, fragrance-free aur non-comedogenic.
- Brand ke according in-vivo testing mein SPF 56 measure hua. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/skin-body-1/products/light-fluid-spf-50-sunscreen?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **₹300–450 ke around** mil raha hai, size/offer ke hisaab se.

**Meri first choice** agar aapko ek hi sunscreen lena hai.

### 🥈 Oily/combination skin: Dot & Key Watermelon Cooling
### [Dot & Key Watermelon Cooling Sunscreen]()
*₹263*

Gel-type, lightweight aur quick-absorbing hai; brand ise SPF 50+ PA++++, non-comedogenic aur zero-white-cast formula batata hai. [www.dotandkey.com](https://www.dotandkey.com/blogs/skin-care/dermatologist-recommended-sunscreens-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 🥉 Sensitive skin: Conscious Chemist 100% Mineral
### [Conscious Chemist Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++]()
*₹154*

Agar aap **mineral sunscreen** prefer karte ho, iska SPF 50 PA++++ version specifically zero-white-cast claim karta hai. [consciouschemist.com](https://consciouschemist.com/products/100-percent-mineral-sunscreen-spf-50-pa-matte-finish-zero-white-cast?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Short answer:** Agar aap mujhe apni **skin type (oily/dry/combination) + budget** bata do, toh main aapke liye **exact 2–3 best sunscreens** choose kar dunga — aur bataunga kaunsa tanning/pigmentation ke liye better hai.
